$comment: Testimonials display-only styling. DEVELOPER CONFIG, not editable copy — do NOT hand this to the CMS. `avatarGradients` maps a testimonial id to the Tailwind gradient used for its initials disc; `fallbackGradient` covers any id not listed (so adding a testimonial can never crash). `avatarBadges` are the four decorative circles in the bottom 'Join 100+ businesses' pill — initials only, no real identity implied. These are Tailwind class fragments, so they must stay as complete static strings for the JIT to generate them.
